mapper.sql: select d.document_id, d.knowledge_base_id, k.knowledge_base_name, d.document_title, d.current_version_id, v.version_no as current_version_no, v.original_file_name, v.file_extension, v.file_size, v.process_status, v.process_message, v.page_count, v.index_status, v.index_message, v.indexed_chunk_count, d.status, d.del_flag, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.update_by, d.update_time, d.remark from oc_document d left join oc_knowledge_base k on k.knowledge_base_id = d.knowledge_base_id left join oc_document_version v on v.document_version_id = d.current_version_id
mapper.select: select count(1) from oc_document d join oc_document_version v on v.document_version_id = d.current_version_id where d.del_flag = '0' and v.del_flag = '0' and ( v.process_status in ('0', '1') or (v.process_status = '2' and v.index_status in ('0', '1')) )
select count(1) from oc_document where knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} and del_flag = '0'

select v.document_version_id from oc_document d inner join oc_document_version v on v.document_version_id = d.current_version_id and v.document_id = d.document_id where d.knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} and d.status = '0' and d.del_flag = '0' and v.process_status = '2' and v.index_status = '2' and v.indexed_chunk_count > 0 and v.del_flag = '0' order by v.document_version_id
mapper.update: update oc_document set document_title = #{documentTitle}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark} where document_id = #{documentId} and del_flag = '0'
update oc_document set current_version_id = #{currentVersionId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where document_id = #{documentId} and del_flag = '0'
